---
{
  "title": "Link",
  "description": "Use link utilities from the configured Tremplin utility map.",
  "group": "Utilities",
  "lead": "Use link utilities from the configured Tremplin utility map.",
  "order": 33,
  "utility": {
    "category": "Type",
    "classes": [
      "link-10",
      "link-20",
      "link-30",
      "link-40",
      "link-50",
      "link-60",
      "link-70",
      "link-80",
      "link-90",
      "link-100",
      "hover:link-100"
    ],
    "notes": "Link opacity mixes --trm-link-color in ten-step percentages. Only hover states are generated by default; focus and old hyphen-state aliases are absent. This example explicitly uses the emphasized link-color token for readable text; lower alpha is not a contrast guarantee.",
    "responsive": false
  }
}
---

import Code from '../../../components/shortcodes/Code.astro'
import Html from '../../../components/shortcodes/Html.astro'
import { utilitiesExamples as samples } from '../../../data/utilities-examples'

<section class="docs-section" aria-labelledby="section-0">
<h2 id="section-0">{"Example"}</h2>

<div class="docs-example"><Html source={samples["utilities/link"][0].example} /></div>

<Code sample={samples["utilities/link"][0].code[0]} standalone={false} />

</section>

<section class="docs-section" aria-labelledby="section-1">
<h2 id="section-1">{"Supported classes"}</h2>

<p><Html source={"Link opacity mixes --trm-link-color in ten-step percentages. Only hover states are generated by default; focus and old hyphen-state aliases are absent. This example explicitly uses the emphasized link-color token for readable text; lower alpha is not a contrast guarantee."} /></p>

<Code sample={samples["utilities/link"][1].code[0]} standalone={true} />

</section>

<section class="docs-section" aria-labelledby="section-2">
<h2 id="section-2">{"Configuration and limits"}</h2>

<p><Html source={"Do not infer responsive, dark, print or state variants from a base selector. Family definitions and helper layers have separate contracts. The default declarations have normal priority; inspect configuration and generated CSS before adding flags."} /></p>

</section>

<section class="docs-section" aria-labelledby="section-3">
<h2 id="section-3">{"Verification"}</h2>

<p><Html source={"Test actual content at narrow widths, in both directions, after changing theme/OS preference, and with zoom and supported assistive technology. Role names, reduced alpha and decorative effects are not accessibility guarantees."} /></p>

<p><Html source={"Continue to <a href=\"/utilities/api/\">Utility API</a> for configuration and pinned limitations. Compiled selectors prove availability, not universal browser feature support."} /></p>

</section>
